This validates new cross-syntax relations within the FIT corpus, not held-out text, and the run contains no unrelated endpoint control. Historical result did not bind a checkpoint digest.

Held-out transfer screen. SELECT nouns and prompt templates are disjoint from FIT, and the two sites were preselected on FIT. The matched within-group donor changes syntax and subject number while holding noun identity and attractor number fixed. This run has no unrelated endpoint control and therefore does not establish held-out selectivity. Historical result did not bind a checkpoint digest.

Held-out counterfactual-robustness screen. SELECT nouns/templates are disjoint from FIT, and each donor comes from a different noun group while preserving the target subject-number direction and attractor plurality. Matched-noun and cross-noun mean recoveries differ by only 0.00166 for head 11.3. The direct v1 and incomplete-publication v2 files are noncanonical; this event uses the managed v3 ledger receipt. No unrelated endpoint control was run, so this is not selectivity.
